steps.label: Slippage
steps.sub: expected price vs. actual fill price

eyebrow: Charge cost on the CHANGE, not the position
code:
trade_value = position.diff().abs() * price
cost = trade_value * (cost_bps / 10_000)
net_pnl = gross_pnl - cost
caption: Holding is free; changing a position is not. Turnover drives cost.

eyebrow: Slippage always works against the trader
code:
vol = price.pct_change().rolling(20).std()
slip = k * (vol * price)
fill_buy = price + slip
fill_sell = price - slip
caption: Slippage scales with volatility; never randomly helps the trader.

subtitle: What happens when your own order size moves the price.
